competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease its Attack Power for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 3 times. Each hit decreases their Defense for 2 turns with a 30% chance and their Attack Bar by 20% with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Stacks 1 Adrenaline score whenever you attack the enemy, up to 5 scores. The damage you take decreases by up to 25% based on your Adrenaline score. At 3 or higher Adrenaline scores, [Whirl] can be used regardless of its cooldown. You lose 1 Adrenaline score and increase your Attack Bar by 50% when you are attacked by the enemy. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
Decreases damage received by a certain amount
effets.note: Up to 25% based on your Adrenaline score
